title: TGN
description: tgn.com.ar zoominfo.com/c/transportadora-de-gas-del-norte/372392284 Transportadora de Gas del Norte (TGN) is Argentina's largest natural gas transporter, publicly traded on BYMA (TGNO4), founded in 1992 and operating 11,317 km of pipelines and 22 compressor stations across 17 provinces. It moves 40% of all natural gas in Argentina's pipeline system (~20% of the national energy matrix) and is the only operator connecting Argentina to Chile, Brazil, Bolivia, and Uruguay. FY2025 revenue was ~$483M (AR$600.6B, +20%), EBITDA ~$260M (55% margin), and net income surged +351% to ~$176M, driven by tariff reforms and Vaca Muerta export growth. The company has virtually zero debt (Debt/EBITDA 0.2x), $250M cash, and pays record dividends of AR$577/share (~10% yield), with a AA-(arg) credit rating (Fitch, positive outlook). It employs 600–1,153 people, is controlled by Gasinvest (56%) — a Techint/Tecpetrol + CGC/Eurnekian joint venture — and was named a Great Place to Work Top-25 in Argentina 2025
